cues: A level one diagram for result processing.
The subject teacher sends marks to process one, record marks, which stores them in the marks file.
Process two computes the result from the marks and the student file, and process three prints the mark sheet for the student.
Each process is numbered, each arrow names its data.
And data never jumps from one store to another, or from an entity to a store, without passing through a process.
